geometry_ring_415075.note:
Where a deaf body's posture signal is lost inside the proprioception encoder, and what the heading does to it
(light: rings read lazily, encoders from model.safetensors, float32 on the CPU, 2 threads).

For each ring (the lesson's window: the last 6,000 moments, every 5th, rebuilt inputs) and each encoder, per body and
per LayerNorm k (three hidden LayerNorms, then the registry's output LayerNorm):
  const  = the body's time-mean pre-normalisation vector, centred over its 192 numbers, root mean square per number
  moment = the moment part (the vector minus the body's time-mean), root mean square per number over the window
  share  = moment / sqrt(const^2 + moment^2): the moment part's share of what the LayerNorm divides by
  after  = the spread over time after that LayerNorm (mean over numbers of the standard deviation), the non-affine
           normalisation as the registry applies it at the output (hidden LayerNorms: their own gain and bias)
The heading test: every body's rows turned about the vertical to another body's mean heading.

drift_340526_343139.note:
Which encoder-only pressure the proprioception encoder's actual drift follows (light).

Span W0 -> W1 (two checkpoints of one lineage). On W0's ring (the lesson's window of rebuilt inputs, and the ring's
consecutive moments), at W0's weights and W0's saved Adam second moments (P = 1 / (sqrt(v_hat) + eps)):
  residual  the next-moment lesson's path into the encoder through the head's `+ current`, with the head taken as
            predicting no change (the model never beat "nothing changes" on this sense): mse(c(x_t-1), sg(c(x_t))),
            one pair per body per step, 8 bodies (weight 1: next_frame_norm.weighted_term)
  vicreg    VICReg's proprioception share across the 8 bodies at one moment (variance 1.0, covariance 0.04, / 6 senses)
  decay     AdamW's decoupled weight decay on the decayed tensors (-W)
For each: the per-step update it contributes, -lr x P x gradient (decay: -lr x wd x W), times the span's steps; its
cosine with the actual drift W1 - W0; and its first-order change of every body's token spread over the lesson's
window (the spread's gradient dotted with it), beside the measured change of that spread from W0 to W1 on the same
inputs.
